card.line: Mount Zalmon is a dark, tree-covered hill near Shechem, where Abimelech and his men cut branches to burn the tower of Shechem.

moments.title: Branches cut for fire
moments.text: Abimelech and all his men went up Mount Zalmon, where he cut a branch from the trees and told his men to do the same. They piled the branches against the tower of Shechem and set it on fire, killing about a thousand men and women.
